 Exceptional English writing, editing, and structural formatting skills, with a portfolio displaying clean, jargon\-free technical guides.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Frontend Developer / Delhi,Noida
description:
We are seeking a talented and passionate Frontend Developer to build modern, responsive, and high\-performing web applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in frontend technologies and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences through clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate closely with designers, backend developers, product managers, and QA teams to develop interactive web interfaces that meet business requirements and deliver outstanding user engagement. You will contribute to application development, UI implementation, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives while staying current with emerging frontend technologies and industry best practices.
   

  

 This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on innovative digital products, modern web technologies, and scalable software solutions within a collaborative engineering environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Frontend Development
   

  

* Develop high\-quality, responsive, and interactive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks.
* Build reusable UI components and scalable frontend modules that support long\-term application growth.
* Translate UI/UX designs, wireframes, and business requirements into functional web interfaces.
* Ensure seamless user experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Implement responsive design principles and cross\-browser compatibility standards.


 Application Enhancement \& Optimization
   

  

* Optimize application performance, page load speed, and frontend efficiency.
* Maintain and enhance existing web applications by implementing new features and improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve frontend\-related issues, bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
* Ensure code quality through testing, debugging, and adherence to development standards.
* Continuously improve usability, accessibility, and user engagement across digital platforms.


 Collaboration \& Development
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, backend developers, and QA engineers.
* Participate in project planning, sprint reviews, and technical discussions.
* Contribute innovative ideas and technical solutions to improve products and development processes.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Support the implementation of frontend best practices and coding standards.


 Continuous Learning \& Innovation
   

  

* Stay updated with emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.
* Research and evaluate new tools and technologies to improve development efficiency.
* Contribute to process improvements, workflow automation, and development optimization initiatives.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the engineering team.


**Required Skills**
 Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building responsive and mobile\-friendly web applications.
* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Understanding of component\-based architecture and reusable UI development.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs.
* Knowledge of browser developer tools, debugging techniques, and performance optimization.
* Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
* Understanding of web accessibility standards and responsive design principles.


 Professional Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality code.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business needs.

* Experience with TypeScript.

* Understanding of Agile or Scrum development methodologies.
* Exposure to cloud\-based application environments.

title: Full Stack Developer (70-80% Backend & 20-30% Frontend)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 You will be working together with a team of professionals with both technical software knowledge and rail domain knowledge striving to raise the rain safety with as ultimate goal to achieve the best possible level of rail safety.
   

  

 You will be part of a SCRUM team of experienced developers, domain experts and the product owner who deliver software to Prorail. We deliver complex software systems in which knowledge of the railway industry, and the associated jargon, is integral. It is essential that the systems that we deliver integrate seamlessly – this places high demands on our quality to deliver. After each sprint (2 weeks) there will be a demo for stakeholders (from RIGD\-Loxia. ProRail and others)
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Minimum 5\+ Years of experience as a Full Stack Developer
* As a Full Stack \-Java \-Angular developer you could be a perfect match: (Java technology 70\- 80% \- Angular technology 20\-30%)
* You take ownership and guarantee the quality of the software;
* You work closely with the product owner, other developers and testers;
* As team member you are actively involved with preparation of new stories, refinements, planning and design meetings;
* You can work independently but also in pair\-programming;
* You develop in line with the clean code and clean architecture principles;
* You are inclined to always help the tester;
* You build it, you run it is your rule\-of\-thought.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Backend Experience:**
* Java v17\+, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security
* REST APIs, JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI
* Need experience kubernetes, docker, pipelines and cloud infrastructure
* DevOps \& Tools: Git, Maven, Jenkins
* Testing: JUnit, Mockito, Integration Testing


**Frontend Experience:**
* Angular v17\+
* Basic experience working with state management libraries such as NgRx, NGXS, or Akita, along with a good understanding of
* Redux patterns and a strong willingness to learn and grow
* Basic experience with reactive programming using RxJS, along with an eagerness to further enhance skills in this area.
* Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, CI/CD
* IDEs \& Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code


**Good to have:**
* Knowledge of clean architecture/layered architecture
* Knowledge of the railway domain (Nice to have).
* Demonstrably a minimum of 6\+ years experience programming in Java 17\+ and Angular 17 experience – preferably over several projects and with a recent version


**Why Arcadis?**
 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**
 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

title: Freelance Frontend Developer (Landing Pages & Websites)
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled F
 **rontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js)** 
 to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build high\-quality landing pages and multi\-page websites within our hybrid AI \+ human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot \- that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift \- you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide frontend craftsmanship, design sensibility, and quality control to ensure pixel\-perfect, conversion\-ready websites that match real client briefs. This part\-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in landing page production, multi\-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real\-world expertise from across the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi\-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion\-focused layouts
* Build small multi\-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture
* Implement responsive, mobile\-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers
* Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources
* Apply on\-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against
* Evaluate AI\-generated frontend output and refine markup, styling, structure, and copy placement to production quality
* Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross\-browser issues independently


**Requirements And Benefits**
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus
* Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high\-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion\-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and refine AI\-assisted output into production\-ready interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar)
* Experience with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries
* Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code
* Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar)
* Working knowledge of on\-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals
* Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic
* Self\-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision
* Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required)
* English proficiency: Upper\-intermediate (B2\) or above (required)


**Project time expectations**
 For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10\-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
   

  

**Compensation**
 On this project, contributors can earn up to
 **$35 per hour equivalent** 
 , depending on their level and pace of contribution.
   

  

 Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
   

  

**Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?**
* Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection
* Gain hands\-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field
* Participate in performance\-based bonus programs that reward high\-quality work and consistent delivery

* Generate HR MIS reports related to manpower, payroll, attendance, attrition, and statutory compliance for management review.
* Address employee queries related to payroll, benefits, leave, and HR policies.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts departments for payroll reconciliation and statutory payments.
* Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures, and process improvements.
* Support recruitment, employee engagement activities, and other HR operational requirements as needed.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in Payroll, Statutory Compliance, and HR Operations.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, payroll processes, PF, ESI, PT, Gratuity, Bonus, and other statutory requirements.
* Experience in handling HRMS and payroll software.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HR reporting.

description:
**Taxation Manger \- Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Indirect Taxation (GST \& Works Contract)**

**Construction \& Contracting**

* Manage GST compliance including GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9, and annual reconciliations.
* Oversee GST applicability under Works Contract provisions.
* Ensure accurate ITC reconciliation with GSTR\-2A/2B.
* Monitor RCM applicability on subcontractor and unregistered vendor payments.
* Ensure compliance for interstate stock transfers and SEZ transactions.
* Advise project teams on tax implications during tendering and contract structuring.

**Entertainment Industry**

* Oversee GST compliance for\-Ticket sales \& event revenues, Revenue\-sharing arrangements
* Ensure correct place\-of\-supply treatment for multi\-state events.
* Monitor GST treatment of digital and streaming revenues (if applicable).

**2\. Direct Taxation \& Withholding Compliance**

* Ensure correct deduction and remittance of TDS on:
* Contractor \& subcontractor payments
* Professional \& consultancy fees
* Rent \& commission
* Artist/celebrity payments
* File quarterly TDS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q).
* Manage advance tax calculations and corporate tax planning.
* Coordinate Income Tax return filings and tax audits.
* Handle notices, scrutiny assessments, and departmental queries.

**3\. Consolidated Financial Oversight**

**Consolidated Financial Statements**

* Oversee preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements for all group entities.
* Ensure elimination of inter\-company transactions during consolidation.
* Support CFO in preparing board\-level financial reports.

**Inter\-company Reconciliation**

* Ensure all cross\-entity transactions are reconciled monthly.
* Prevent elimination errors and mismatches in group financials.
* Maintain detailed documentation for related\-party transactions.

**4\. Audit Management**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, and tax auditors.
* Ensure smooth completion of Group Audit processes.
* Facilitate timely finalization of books and audit schedules.
* Address audit observations and implement corrective controls.
* Support management during due diligence exercises.

**5\. Budgetary Control \& Financial Monitoring**

* Monitor “Budget vs. Actual” performance across business units.
* Analyze cost variances in projects, events, and retail operations.
* Alert CFO of significant financial deviations.
* Provide tax impact analysis on budget variances.
* Support financial forecasting and tax provisioning.

**6\. Receivables \& Payables Oversight**

* Supervise AR/AP teams to maintain healthy working capital.
* Review aging reports for:
* Project\-based receivables
* Retail \& event\-based customers
* Ensure timely vendor payments while optimizing cash flow.
* Monitor doubtful debts and provisioning requirements.
* Oversee compliance in vendor tax documentation (GST, PAN, etc.).

**7\. Labour \& Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely remittance and filing of:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax (Tamil Nadu norms)
* Ensure compliance with labour\-related tax obligations for site workers.
* Coordinate with HR and payroll teams for statutory accuracy.

**8\. Risk Management \& Compliance Controls**

* Develop and maintain a tax compliance calendar.
* Conduct periodic internal tax reviews and risk assessments.
* Implement internal financial controls across group entities.
* Keep management updated on amendments in GST, Income Tax, and state regulations impacting construction and entertainment sectors.

**Qualifications**

* CA (Mandatory Preferred)
* CMA / CA Inter (with strong taxation exposure) may be considered
* Additional GST certification preferred

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in taxation \& finance
* Strong exposure to Construction / EPC / Works Contract taxation
* Experience in entertainment/event management taxation (preferred)
* Experience in handling multi\-entity group consolidation

description:
Dear Prospective Applicants,

Greetings!

Hope this e\-communication finds you well!

We are in look\-out for Hostel Warden in a renowned medical institute located in Bengaluru Rural, details of which are as following:

**Job Position** : Hostel Warden.

**Location** : Bengaluru Rural (H*oskote*).

**Qualification** : Graduate / Post Graduate with relevant experience.

**Compensation** : Commensurate with qualification and experience.

Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:

* Warden shall periodically check the working, discipline, cleanliness and all other aspects of general administration of the hostel.
* Warden shall ensure that no ragging takes place inside the hostel premises and maintain strict watch over the same.
* Updates / Hostel statement i.e., sharing of rooms, vacated rooms, duration of stay, newly joined students to be given to the accounts department from time to time.
* Students are allowed to go to his/ her home only after prior approval from Principal / CEO. The same has to be entered in the register and keep a track of the same.
* Monitor whether the students have returned on time after the holidays/ leave.
* Warden should ensure whether the students are regular to the classes \- a check should be made.
* Co\-ordinate with maintenance department for any Hostel maintenance related issue and log book to be maintained.
* In case any student is sick, care to be taken including arrangement of food and coordinate for initial diagnosis to be made.
* To have a proper interaction with students and identify any issues related to hostel.
* To ensure maintenance of discipline in and around the hostel premises.
* The laundry bags of the students to be handed over to the laundry staff and after completion to be handed over to the students. The collected amount has to be submitted to the accounts department.
* Monitor sufficient availability of dinking water, electricity, lighting, and other basic amenities to the students.
* Periodic surprise checks at (random) rooms to find out if any prohibited items like cigarette, liquor, non\-beg and contraband items are used by the students. If found, to seize the same and bring to the notice of the Principal/ CEO for further action.
* If any students are found using expensive and power consuming electrical or electronic gadgets (including electric stove \& cooker) \- the same has to be confiscated and brought to the notice of the CEO for further action.
* To have strict vigil on the movement of the students inside the campus.
* Bringing friends / parents / relatives in the pretext of relatives for overnight stay is strictly prohibited.
* Celebrating birthday and other parties should be done only during day time in the authorized place with prior permission of reporting manager not inside the hostel premises, at any given time. The same as to be brought to the notice of Principal / CEO.
* Warden shall ensure to report any instance of workplace Sexual Harassment of student or the staff to the prevention of Sexual Harassment committee.
* Any other responsibility assigned by Principal / CEO from time to time.
* Hostel Warden shall ensure to maintain log book and provide periodical report to the CEO.
* Hostel Wardens are not supposed to the campus without prior permission of CEO.
* Log Book for food to be maintained y the Wardens.
* Warden shall ensure not to collect any financial favors or gift in cash or by any other means from any students during the service in the institution, not any unauthorized fine from students, to which extent \- a separate undertaking needs to be provided to the management.

Should this role be of interest and relevance to your credentials, please mail your updated profile to "**srmgrhr\- at \- mvjmc. edu. in**" or "**headhr\- at \- mvjmc. edu. in**". Alternatively, you may would like to connect with us on **080\-2806 0200 Extn. 501 / 080\-2806 0299**.

Should this opportunity not be of interest or relevance, request the recipient to either share among your professional clique for the information to be passed on to the potential job aspirant.

Thanking You,

With Regards,

Team \- HR

Trigon Digipack Pvt Ltd is looking for a dynamic, detail\-oriented HR Operations Executive with 1 to 3 years of experience to manage day\-to\-day employee operations, attendance, and payroll processing. title: Market Research Intern
description:
**Position:** Market Research \& Lead Generation Intern  
**Company:** Trellent  
**Location:** Remote (Work from Anywhere)  
**Work Hours:** Target\-Based (Monday to Friday ONLY. Weekends strictly off.)

**About Trellent:**  
Trellent is an Official Google Cloud Partner and a Government Registered MSME. We engineer custom AI and WhatsApp automation systems that help Indian businesses stop losing customers to slow replies. While our clients sleep, our systems automatically answer inquiries, book appointments, and secure sales. We operate efficiently: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We respect time, we strictly protect your weekends, and we maintain a highly professional work culture.

**The Reality of This Role (Please Read Carefully):**  
If you are looking for a standard internship where you sit at a desk for 8 hours just to get a basic participation certificate, this is not for you. We do not track your screen. We do not count your hours. We focus purely on results. Your job is to act as the market research engine for our company. You will identify local businesses across India that are losing revenue and actively need our technology to grow.

**What You Will Actually Do (Daily Tasks):**

* Client Sourcing: You will use Google Maps and digital directories to find local businesses (Clinics, Real Estate, Gyms) in specific Indian cities.
* Quality Qualification: You will not select every business. You will specifically identify businesses with 3\.0 to 4\.2 stars—these are the owners who have the budget but are losing customers due to slow, manual replies.
* Database Management: You will accurately log these qualified prospects into our central company database.
* Dynamic Link Generation: You will create highly personalized strategy links for each business. Our sales team will use these exact links to present custom solutions and close the deal.

**Your Journey (Day 1 to End of Internship) Day 1 (The Strategy Blueprint):** 

* You will be added to the Trellent Operations Hub. You will learn the exact market research processes that top tech companies use to find premium clients.
* Daily Routine (The Freedom Rule): You will be given a specific daily target of businesses to find. If you are focused and hit your target in 2 hours, your workday is over. You are free to log off and enjoy your day. We do not micro\-manage.
* Weekends (Strictly Off): Saturday and Sunday are completely off. No work discussions, no company messages. We respect your personal time and mental focus.
* Month 1 to 3 (Skill Scaling): As you get faster and smarter at analyzing the market, your daily targets will gradually increase. You will learn how to read business data like a true professional.
* End of Internship (The Core Team): Top performers who consistently hit their targets will be elevated to our Core Team. You will receive an Official Letter of Recommendation (highly valued by future employers), an MSME Verified Certificate, and a direct interview for a permanent, paid Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO).

**Who We Are Looking For:**

* You have a laptop, a stable internet connection, and a strong desire to learn real business skills.
* You understand basic English and know how to use Google Search smartly.
* You dislike corporate micro\-management and want the freedom to work based on targets, not time.

**How to Apply:** 

Reply to this message with your resume and a 1\-line message on why your  
work speed and focus make you the right fit for this role.

Job Types: Part\-time, Contractual / Temporary, Fresher, Internship, Student job  
Contract length: 3 months

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Mindset Check: Are you committed to an intensive 3\-month unpaid mentorship to build real business skills, or just looking for a basic certificate? (Be honest).
* 2\. Professional Value: Why should our core team invest time mentoring you over other applicants?
* 3\. Resilience Test: Professional consulting involves rejection. How will you handle hearing "No" while maintaining your focus?
* 4\. Attention to Detail: To prove you read this thoroughly, you MUST start your message below with "I am ready for the Core Team". (Applications missing this are automatically rejected).

**Description:**About IHCL

Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) is a part of the Tata Group and is one of South Asia's largest and most iconic hospitality companies. With a legacy of over 120 years, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our guests through our diverse portfolio of hotels, resorts, and palaces.
Careers at IHCL

At IHCL, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a dynamic work environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. Join us in creating memorable experiences and shaping the future of hospitality. Explore exciting career opportunities with us and be a part of a vibrant team that values passion, excellence, and diversity.
Job Objective

This position exists for leading and managing all aspects of security and safety operations at a property. This role ensures compliance with safety standards, fire and life safety regulations, and IHCL protocols. It includes leading the S\&S team, overseeing risk management, responding to emergencies, and managing safety and security initiatives to protect guests, staff, and property.

Essential Job Tasks

Leads the security and safety function for a mid\-to\-large property, coordinating risk mitigation strategies and overseeing crisis management protocols. Manages security teams, reviews incident reports, and ensures regulatory compliance. Implements fire and life safety programs, oversees security technology systems, and conducts regular audits. Provides training to staff and develops proactive safety and security measures.

Areas of Responsibility

1\. Leadership and Team Management.  

* Leadership of Security \& Safety Operations. Lead the S\&S team in day\-to\-day security and safety operations, ensuring high standards in staff deployment, incident response, and proactive risk management. Foster a culture of excellence in security and safety performance among all team members.
* Supervision of Team Members. Manage the performance of security supervisors, safety officers, and stewards, ensuring they are executing their duties as per property standards. Monitor team adherence to schedules, patrol assignments, and guest/staff interactions.
* Team Training and Development. Oversee the continuous training and development of the security and safety team, ensuring they are up\-to\-date on security protocols, emergency response procedures, and IHCL standards. Conduct performance evaluations and recommend promotions or additional training as needed.

2\. Security \& Safety Strategy and Planning.  

* Strategic Planning of Security Operations. Develop and implement security and safety strategies for the property, aligned with IHCL’s broader goals and objectives. This includes property\-specific risk management plans, preventive security strategies, and fire/life safety initiatives.
* Policy Development \& Enforcement. Ensure that all security and safety policies are developed, implemented, and enforced across the property. Regularly review and update security and safety policies to ensure alignment with evolving regulatory requirements and best practices.

3\. Security \& Surveillance Systems Management.  

* Access Control \& Monitoring. Oversee the management of access control systems, ensuring that entry and exit points are secure and monitored at all times. Ensure security systems (e.g., CCTV, electronic surveillance) are operational and functioning optimally.
* Surveillance System Upkeep. Ensure that all CCTV and surveillance systems are routinely inspected, maintained, and upgraded as needed. Oversee real\-time monitoring processes and ensure operators are trained to identify and escalate security risks.
* Electronic Access Management. Manage electronic access control systems and ensure proper logging and reporting of access to restricted areas.

4\. Risk Management \& Mitigation.  

* Risk Assessments. Conduct regular and comprehensive risk assessments to identify potential security and safety vulnerabilities on the property. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address identified vulnerabilities.
* Incident Response \& Crisis Management. Lead the S\&S team in responding to incidents, including security breaches, safety violations, and emergencies such as fire or medical crises. Serve as the key point of contact for emergency services and law enforcement during incidents.

description:
**Job Description**  

About the Job


This role is responsible for leading an end\-to\-end team of approximately 60 associates supporting Business Intelligence delivery for our large global manufacturer clients in North America (G14 Clients).


As the North America G14 Clients Leader, you will be the front\-facing point of contact to internal and external clients, including in\-market leader(s), to lead and drive the strategy of our Business Intelligence teams in the service and output provided across various areas.


The role is responsible for representing the G14 Business Intelligence within Pune GCC for this client portfolio — strategizing, bringing a uniform culture, streamlining processes, and increasing collaboration to achieve a One Team approach.


This role involves maintaining and leading a sizeable team; hence, you will be responsible for the employee experience and the development of associates. In addition, this role will be critical in driving the development and incorporation of AI tools into our Business Intelligence practice.


Responsibilities


Business Intelligence Delivery \& Employee Experience

* Lead a high\-performing team of leads, associates, and program managers, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and results\-driven culture of engagement, growth, empowerment, and excitement.
* Develop and execute the strategy and plan for growth of the G14 client delivery organization, including service consistency and process optimization for a quality team structure.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with leaders from product engineering, services delivery, and technical sales to resolve issues promptly and recommend innovations that help the customer and support operations.
* Develop and align standardized metrics that reflect the health of the team and overall customer sentiment.
* Communicate effectively with senior staff and corporate workstreams on key issues while partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Manage customer escalations and relationships, working with customers on support issues, individual support plans, and customer requests.
* Ensure customer satisfaction reflects the highest quality of output delivery and follow up with customers on survey feedback regularly.


Client Engagement \& Delivery Strategy

* Establish a strategy to grow the business by delivering high\-quality and relevant solutions to large global manufacturer clients.
* Build and retain a high\-performing team focused on providing world\-class service.
* Bring the voice of the clients (in\-market, onshore) into internal business planning discussions around service development.
* Support solutions development by enabling the customer discovery process.
* Frequently measure and improve upon customer satisfaction metrics.
* Build relationships and chart strategies with in\-market teams and onshore leaders to ensure standardization and uniformity of processes and employee engagement.
* Quickly adapt to the deployment of new products, services, and changes.


Employee Engagement

* Build meaningful relationships with employees at all levels of the local team to instil pride, accountability \& ownership..
* Strategically lead and develop a team of direct and indirect reports and create a vision for talent development within the team.
* Adapt the flex\-work initiative and build a uniform, employee\-friendly culture by leveraging Company culture and bringing in industry best practices.
* Help ensure the Company is seen as a great place to work for the diverse profiles relevant to our future business.
* Recruit, lead, develop, and engage a high\-performing team.
* Work closely with the BI leader , HR Business Partners and relevant stakeholders to develop and implement strategic career paths and talent development.


Workforce Management

* Build, plan, and execute operating plans for the team with a focus on driving higher levels of client and stakeholder support and allocating resources toward critical accounts while driving productivity.
* Define and execute plans to ensure employee attrition stays manageable and does not jeopardize growth ambitions.
* Get personally involved in critical situations — guiding and coaching the team to make every input a winning service.
* Work with functional teams to improve service levels and automate processes.
* Strategize with HR Business Partners on team structuring and ensuring the relevance of every associate at every level.


AI Enablement in Business Intelligence


A defining focus of this role is to champion the adoption of AI across the BI practice, serving as a key expert and advocate for embedding AI tooling into how the team delivers for clients.

* Provide hands\-on expertise toward the development, evaluation, and incorporation of AI tools into Business Intelligence workflows and deliverables.
* Identify high\-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation to increase quality, speed, and organizational efficiency.
* Partner with product engineering, data management, and BI COE programs to pilot, scale, and operationalize AI capabilities across the team.
* Build team capability and literacy in AI tools, establishing best practices, guardrails, and responsible\-use standards.
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies and translate them into practical, measurable improvements for client delivery.

 **Qualifications**  

* The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 7\+ years of experience in Research and Analytics, working with Business Intelligence Management or Operations divisions. The ideal candidate should also possess, at a minimum, the following qualifications and attributes:
* Experience in developing and implementing strategic business plans; a demonstrated capability to balance short\-term focus with long\-term planning to deliver business objectives.
* Strong leadership and strategic thinking; preferred experience in building organizational capabilities (lean operations; project and talent management).
* Hands\-on exposure to AI and automation tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to analytics and delivery workflows.
* Solid track record of engagement and delivery of research or related solutions or projects.
* A passion for data, insights, and improvement.
* Strong operational acumen.
* Experience in negotiation and conflict management.
* A client\-centric approach that favors problem solving and long\-term value creation.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to manage numerous stakeholders.
* Strong influencing skills.
* Excellent cross\-functional cooperation skills.
* Excellent written and oral skills in English.
* Multi\-functional business experience leading dynamic organizations, including strong team leadership experience.

Job Summary:

The Employee Relations Executive is responsible for supporting employee engagement, retention, grievance resolution, policy implementation, and employee communication initiatives within the organization. The role acts as a bridge between employees and management, ensuring a positive work environment, timely resolution of employee concerns, and adherence to company policies and labor regulations. The position plays a key role in reducing attrition, improving employee satisfaction, and driving engagement initiatives in a fast\-paced BPO environment.

Key Responsibilities: Employee Relations

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee concerns, queries, and workplace issues.
* Support investigation and resolution of employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict situations.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling employee\-related concerns.
* Ensure proper documentation and closure of employee relation cases.
* Conduct regular employee connect sessions, one\-on\-one meetings, and skip\-level interactions to understand employee concerns and provide timely resolutions.
* Manage employee tickets and ensure adherence to defined turnaround times.

Attrition Management \& Retention

* Conduct attrition analysis and identify trends impacting employee retention.
* Perform shrinkage analysis and share actionable insights with operations and HR stakeholders.
* Execute retention initiatives and win\-back programs for employees who have resigned.
* Conduct stay interviews and employee feedback discussions.
* Support referral drives to meet hiring requirements.
* Track and report retention metrics regularly.

Employee Engagement

* Plan and execute employee engagement activities as per the engagement calendar.
* Coordinate weekly and monthly Rewards \& Recognition (R\&R) programs.
* Conduct Employee Satisfaction (ESAT) surveys and analyze results.
* Organize employee wellness, cultural, and team\-building initiatives.
* Ensure high participation and effectiveness of engagement programs.

Internal Job Posting (IJP) Management

* Coordinate and manage the Internal Job Posting (IJP) process.
* Communicate available opportunities and eligibility criteria.
* Track applications, coordinate assessments/interviews, and provide updates to stakeholders.
* Maintain IJP records and generate periodic reports.

Compliance \& Policy Implementation

* Ensure employees are aware of company policies, code of conduct, and workplace guidelines.
* Support implementation of HR policies and standard operating procedures.
* Assist in POSH awareness initiatives and mandatory compliance trainings.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company regulations.

Communication \& Employee Support

* Draft and circulate employee communications, announcements, and engagement updates.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions related to company policies and culture.
* Support change management initiatives and organizational communication programs.
* Build positive relationships with employees across all levels.

Reporting \& MIS

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on attrition, shrinkage, employee engagement, and ER activities.
* Maintain employee relations dashboards and trackers.
* Analyze employee feedback and recommend improvement initiatives.
* Present insights and action plans during HR and Operations review meetings.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

description:
**Job Description:**

**Join Our Team: Junior Rebar Detailer (Freshers Welcome!)**

At **Eminent Engineering Services**, we believe that every great structural engineer starts with a strong foundation. We are looking for detail\-oriented, motivated individuals to join our detailing team. Whether you are a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, we provide the environment and mentorship you need to build a successful career in structural engineering.

**The Opportunity**

As a Rebar Detailer, you won’t just be drawing lines; you’ll be translating complex structural designs into the practical blueprints that hold buildings together. Your day\-to\-day will involve:

* **Drafting Precision:** Creating clean, accurate rebar shop drawings.
* **Technical Planning:** Preparing Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) directly from structural plans.
* **Global Standards:** Gaining hands\-on experience working with **US codes and standards**.
* **Collaboration:** Working side\-by\-side with engineers and senior staff to solve technical challenges.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We value curiosity and a strong work ethic over a long resume. You’ll be a great fit if:

* **Education:** You are a 2024, 2025, or 2026 graduate ready to start your professional journey.
* **Experience:** You have **0–3 years** of experience in the field.
* **Technical Skills:** you are comfortable with **AutoCAD** (knowledge of Rebar CAD is a plus!).
* **Analytical Mindset:** You can read structural drawings and have a keen eye for detail.
* **Growth Mindset:** You are eager to learn, take feedback, and advance your skills.

**Why Eminent Engineering Services?**

We know that our strength lies in our people. We offer more than just a paycheck; we offer a place to belong:

* **Compensations:** Monthly salary of **₹16,000 – ₹40,000** (based on experience).
* **Security \& Health:** Comprehensive benefits including **Health Insurance**, **PF**, and paid sick leave.
* **Balance:** We value your time. Enjoy a culture that respects **work\-life balance** and offers leave encashment.
* **Culture:** Join a **friendly, supportive team** that enjoys wellness programs and regular team activities.
* **Perks \& Benefits**: **Maternity Bonus, Marriage Bonus, Child Education Support, Employee Loan without interest.**

**Ready to Start?**

If you’re ready to take the first step in your engineering career, we’d love to meet you.

**How to Apply:** Reach out to our HR team directly at **ssn@eminentenggs.com** or submit your application through this portal. We look forward to building something great together!

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. **Job Description:**

**Job Description Summary**


We are seeking a meticulous and detail\-oriented Accounts Payable Invoice Processor to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and processing invoices, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies, and maintaining strong vendor relationships. This role is crucial for maintaining the financial health and operational efficiency of our organization.

**Job Duties**

* Invoice Processing: Accurately process a high volume of invoices, ensuring all necessary approvals and documentation are obtained.
* Data Entry: Enter invoice details into the accounting system (Oracle), ensuring accuracy and completeness.

* Compliance: Ensure all invoices comply with company policies and procedures, as well as relevant regulatory requirements.
* Reporting: Generate and analyze accounts payable reports to assist in financial planning and decision\-making.
* Support: Assist with month\-end closing activities and provide support to the finance team as needed.

**Key Skills Requirements**

* Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail in processing invoices and data entry.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with vendors and internal teams.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving skills to identify and resolve discrepancies and issues.
* Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
* Qualification: B.Com, BBA or MBA in Finance Freshers. Previous experience in accounts payable or a similar finance role is also preferred.

 **Employee Type:**

  

Permanent  

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Chat Support Executive
description:
SuperWorks is hiring Chat Support Executives to join our Customer Support team. As a Chat Support Executive, you will be the first point of contact for our customers on our live chat platform, answering their questions, resolving their issues, and making every interaction quick, clear, and helpful.

This role is ideal for freshers or early\-career professionals who communicate well in writing, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career in customer support and SaaS. Full product training is provided, so prior experience is welcome but not required.

Because you speak with customers all day, you will also have the chance to earn performance incentives \- by recommending useful upgrades and add\-ons and by referring new leads \- on top of your fixed salary.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Respond to customer queries over live chat promptly, professionally, and with a friendly tone.
* Understand each customer’s problem, troubleshoot it, and guide them to a clear solution.
* Manage several chat conversations at the same time without letting quality slip.
* Escalate complex or technical issues to the relevant team and follow up until they are resolved.
* Spot opportunities to recommend relevant upgrades or add\-ons (cross\-sell and upsell) during conversations, and encourage referrals \- passing qualified leads to the sales team.
* Meet response\-time, resolution\-time, and customer\-satisfaction (CSAT) targets.
* Record conversations accurately and keep customer information up to date.
* Share recurring problems and customer feedback with the product and support teams.
* Help improve our help center by suggesting or drafting support articles.

**Required Skills (Must\-Have) :**

* **Strong English communication is mandatory** .
* Strong reading comprehension to quickly understand what a customer needs.
* A patient, empathetic, and customer\-first attitude.
* Ability to multitask and stay organized while handling multiple chats.
* Comfort using computers and web\-based applications.
* A quick learner who can pick up our product and processes.
* Fresher to 1 year of experience (customer support internships count).

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

description:
Role Summary

We are hiring an E\-commerce Operations \& Systems Executive to manage end\-to\-end e\-commerce operations for

Woollen House. The person will handle daily orders, dispatch, returns, product listings and basic inventory coordination.

Along with this, the person will also help create SOPs, training checklists and audit checklists for Woollen House and

other group businesses.

This role is not only a packing or dispatch role. We need someone who can work fast, avoid mistakes, use computers

properly, document work clearly and help build better systems.

Key Responsibilities

1\. E\-commerce Order Operations

\- Process daily online orders correctly and on time.

\- Pick, check, pack and dispatch orders with proper care.

\- Make sure yarn colours, quantities, variants and SKUs are not mixed up.

\- Generate invoices, shipping labels and tracking details.

\- Coordinate with courier / shipping partners when needed.

\- Maintain clean packing standards and reduce damage or wrong dispatches.

2\. Returns, Exchanges and Order Issues

\- Handle customer returns and exchanges as per company process.

\- Inspect returned products and update whether they can be restocked.

\- Record return reasons and repeated issues.

\- Coordinate with the team for wrong item, damaged item, missing item or delivery issues.

3\. Product Listings and Catalog Work

\- Create and update product listings on Shopify and other platforms if required.

\- Update product names, descriptions, prices, images, variants and stock details.

\- Check listings for spelling errors, wrong prices, wrong images or missing information.

\- Maintain clean product data for yarn colours, weight, material, needle size, category and other product details.

4\. Inventory Coordination

\- Track stock used for online orders.

\- Report low stock, stock mismatch and fast\-moving products.

\- Keep dispatch area and stock area organised.

\- Help with basic stock checks when required.

5\. SOP, Training and Audit Support

\- Create simple SOPs for repeated tasks such as order dispatch, returns, product listing, packing and inventory

checks.

\- Make daily, weekly and monthly checklists for operations.

\- Create simple training material for new team members.

\- Help prepare audit checklists for Woollen House, CIY and Makist processes.

\- Check whether tasks are being done as per the checklist and report gaps.

\- Find repeated mistakes and suggest practical improvements.

Required Skills

\- Good computer skills: Google Sheets, email, browser and basic online tools.

\- Ability to work with Shopify or learn it quickly.

\- High attention to detail, especially for colours, variants, quantities and prices.

\- Basic written English for listings, checklists and simple documentation.

\- Fast, organised and clean working style.

\- Comfortable using AI tools for writing SOPs, checklists and listing improvements.

Qualification

\- Minimum: 12th pass.

\- Preferred: Graduate in any stream.

\- Must be comfortable using computers and online systems.

Experience

\- 1 to 3 years of experience in e\-commerce operations, dispatch, warehouse, catalog, product listings, retail operations

or similar work is preferred.

\- Experience with Shopify, Shiprocket, Amazon, Flipkart or similar platforms will be a strong advantage.

\- Freshers may be considered only if they are very sharp, disciplined, comfortable with computers and fast learners.

Success Measures

\- Same\-day dispatch for eligible orders.

\- Very low packing and dispatch errors.

\- Product listings updated correctly and on time.

\- Returns and exchanges closed quickly and properly recorded.

\- Stock issues reported daily.

\- Useful SOPs, checklists and audit sheets created every month.

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.

description:
**Key Responsibilities \& Duties**

**1\. Production Planning \& Floor Execution**

* **Shift Management:** Plan, allocate, and execute daily production schedules based on targets provided by the Production Manager.
* **Machine Setup \& Optimization:** Set and monitor critical process parameters (temperature, pressure, cycle time, and speed) on plastic processing machinery.
* **Resource Allocation:** Ensure optimal utilization of manpower (operators, helpers) and machines during the shift to maximize output.

**2\. Quality Assurance \& Troubleshooting**

* **Defect Minimization:** Continuously monitor product quality on the floor to minimize rejection rates and scrap generation.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Diagnose and troubleshoot processing defects (e.g., short shots, flashing, shrinkage, silver streaks, warping) and adjust machine settings accordingly.
* **SOP Adherence:** Ensure all operators strictly follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain product consistency.

**3\. Maintenance \& Downtime Management**

* **Preventive Maintenance:** Coordinate with the maintenance team for scheduled servicing of molding machines, molds, and auxiliary equipment (chillers, hopper dryers, granulators).
* **Breakdown Resolution:** Act quickly during mechanical or electrical breakdowns to minimize machine downtime and production loss.

**4\. Manpower Management \& Safety**

* **Shop\-Floor Discipline:** Manage, motivate, and maintain discipline among skilled and unskilled workers in the shift.
* **Safety Compliance:** Enforce the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) like safety shoes, gloves, and earplugs. Ensure strict compliance with factory safety standards to maintain an accident\-free environment.
* **Training:** Conduct on\-the\-job training for new operators regarding machine safety, operation, and quality standards.

**5\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* **Daily Production Reports (DPR):** Maintain accurate logs of raw material consumption, total production yield, rejection details, and downtime, typically managed in Excel.
* **Shift Handover:** Ensure a seamless shift handover by documenting pending tasks, machine statuses, and material counts in the logbook.

**Qualifications \& Key Skills**

* **Education:** Diploma Mechanical / B.E. Mechanical
